Code Generator — C# source code generator from YAML config

Usage:
  codegenerator --config <path> [options]

Options:
  --config,   -c  <path>   (required) Path to the feature YAML config file
  --output,   -o  <path>   Override output root directory
  --templates,-t  <path>   Override templates root directory
  --dry-run,  -d           Preview without writing files
  --help,     -h           Show this help
